related_questions.question: How many days do I wait to take a COVID test?
related_questions.snippet: If you were exposed to someone who has COVID-19 and you do not have symptoms, wait at least 5 full days after your exposure before testing. related_questions.question: How long do PCR results take?
related_questions.snippet: When should I know the results of a PCR test? The results of nasal swab tests for common viruses like influenza and COVID usually take about a day to come back.
